title: List of drugs prohibited for manufacture and sale through gazette notifications under Section 26A of the Drugs & Cosmetics Act, 1940 by the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare

statusNotes.sub-judice: The notifications S.O. 705(E) to S.O. 1048(E) dated 10.03.2016 were quashed by the Hon'ble Delhi High Court vide its order dated 01.12.2016. The Union of India challenged that order before the Supreme Court by way of SLP.
